body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one ally within 4 units. Increase its Movement by 2 until your next turn.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Movement until the start of your next turn.
If this spell directly affects a maintained supernatural effect, suppress one Rank 0 or Rank 1 benefit of that effect until the end of the turn.

rider.title: AIR THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action to let one affected ally move 1 unit after it resolves.
